title: Stock Market Today, April 27: Critical Metals Jumps After Agreeing to Acquire European Lithium in $835 Million Share Deal
title_zh: 今日股市，4 月 27 日：Critical Metals 同意以 8.35 亿美元的股份交易收购欧洲锂业后股价上涨
summary: Today, April 27, 2026, investors are weighing how an $835 million lithium deal reshapes a fast-growing rare earths portfolio.
summary_zh: 今天，即 2026 年 4 月 27 日，投资者正在权衡一笔 8.35 亿美元的锂交易如何重塑快速增长的稀土投资组合。

title: Arista Stock Rebounds After Losing Meta, Oracle Deals To Nvidia
title_zh: 失去 Meta、Oracle 与 Nvidia 的交易后 Arista 股价反弹
summary: With on earnings on deck for next week, AI networking powerhouse Arista stock shakes off a bad Nvidia headline and teases top of buy range.
summary_zh: 随着下周的财报公布，人工智能网络巨头 Arista 的股票摆脱了英伟达糟糕的头条新闻，并触及买入区间的顶部。

title: SiriusXM and iHeartMedia in early merger talks
title_zh: SiriusXM 和 iHeartMedia 正在进行早期合并谈判
summary: A deal would unite the largest terrestrial and satellite radio networks in the U.S., forming a combined company with more than $12 billion in sales
summary_zh: 这笔交易将联合美国最大的地面和卫星广播网络，组建一家销售额超过 120 亿美元的合并公司

title: How The Cementos Pacasmayo (BVL:CPACASC1) Story Is Shifting Around The US$13 Tender Offer
title_zh: Cementos Pacasmayo (BVL:CPACASC1) 的故事如何围绕 13 美元的收购要约发生转变
summary: The latest analyst update on Cementos PacasmayoA keeps fair value steady at PEN6.85, while the price target in US$ terms has been reset to US$13 from US$7.50.
summary_zh: Cementos PacasmayoA 的最新分析师更新将公允价值稳定在 PEN6.85，而以美元计算的价格目标已从 7.50 美元重置为 13 美元。

title: Bloom Energy Oracle Deal Links Fuel Cells To AI Data Center Demand
title_zh: Bloom Energy Oracle 交易将燃料电池与人工智能数据中心需求联系起来
summary: Bloom Energy (NYSE:BE) has expanded its partnership with Oracle under a master services agreement for up to 2.8 GW of fuel cell systems. The agreement focuses on supplying on site power for Oracle's U.S. data centers as AI driven demand for computing capacity grows.
summary_zh: Bloom Energy（纽约证券交易所股票代码：BE）根据一项主服务协议扩大了与 Oracle 的合作伙伴关系，涉及高达 2.8 GW 的燃料电池系统。该协议的重点是随着人工智能驱动的计算能力需求的增长，为甲骨文的美国数据中心提供现场电力。
